# Phase Three — Final Brainstorm Before Execution

The Awtsmoos renews the map and the mapper in one indivisible stream;
Awtsmoos.com must feel like one future made real, not many historical layers sharing a dream.

## Thirty additional refinements

1. Close Comment Thread before Rebbe mutation so unfinished proof does not accumulate.
2. Read Rebbe entry HTML, style manifest, player core, UI player, and audio state as one chain.
3. Read only the CSS modules that actually own player/modals/search before any rewrite.
4. Search for duplicate `.modal`, `#player-bar`, `.cyber-input`, `.result-action` definitions.
5. Determine whether newer premium CSS intentionally overrides older root CSS.
6. Preserve public APIs and event IDs when upgrading markup.
7. Prefer data/state classes over inline style mutation for visible states.
8. Introduce layer tokens only in a small dedicated module if the root already supports CSS variables.
9. Keep negative background canvas layering separate from interactive layers.
10. Clamp context-menu X/Y in JS if CSS alone cannot guarantee viewport containment.
11. Ensure search fullscreen exit remains reachable on 320px width and short heights.
12. Ensure modal close buttons meet a 44px practical touch floor.
13. Ensure generated track action grids collapse cleanly at phone widths.
14. Ensure playlist selection fixed pill can wrap rather than overflow horizontally.
15. Ensure download-task close buttons are not 28px-only touch targets after rewrite.
16. Give range thumbs explicit focus/hover/active treatment.
17. Give checkboxes a custom shell instead of relying only on `accent-color` where visible.
18. Give color inputs a bounded swatch shell rather than raw browser border/chrome.
19. Keep textareas resize behavior deliberate inside studio panels.
20. Ensure long playlist titles/descriptions wrap without widening dialogs.
21. Ensure result cards and track titles use `min-width:0` where grid/flex truncation needs it.
22. Replace `!important` only when ownership can be made structurally stronger; do not blindly strip it.
23. Avoid animations on persistent background layers that cost battery on phones unless reduced-motion and performance are proven.
24. Prefer transform/opacity transitions over layout-thrashing properties.
25. Add empty/error/loading styling contracts for search and playlist sub-surfaces if missing.
26. Add tests for import graph and layer-token usage after code-first changes.
27. Run `git diff --check`, JS syntax, line count, native-media scan, global-selector scan.
28. Use the fresh 8911 server for route-load proof if it remains healthy; otherwise start a new isolated port.
29. Do not hijack browser tabs belonging to other active work.
30. After Rebbe closure, continue immediately to the next native-media candidate, not a report.

## Final architecture choice

Use route-local small modules. Preserve existing IDs/events. Create a Rebbe-specific custom media/control layer only if existing player UI lacks one. Normalize visible controls by subsystem, not globally. Introduce named layer tokens only after tracing the actual fixed/sticky graph. Rewrite complete source files only.
